verdict.rationale: GitCafe documents personal access tokens for the REST API and Git over HTTPS that carry "only the permissions you grant" and "always expire" (gct_ prefix), which covers the permission and expiry parts of the story. Nothing in the evidence shows PATs can be limited to specific repositories; the "Only select repositories" option describes MCP connections, not tokens, so it does not count here. missing for 10: documented per-repository scoping for personal access tokens, details of the available permission granularity and expiry options, independent or hands-on corroboration.
